comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body:
No, this will not work on an aide ship - it will only work on the ship YOUR controlling. You also cant leech this from other fleet members either.

(Keep in mind that most, if not all, ship skills on a aide ship wont work. The only exception is certain battle skills if you call your aide into battle to assist you, though at the expense of the battle exp your get since its shared with the aide.)
